description: Qnity Electronics, Inc. is one of the largest global leaders in materials and solutions for the semiconductor and electronics industries, empowering its customers' technology roadmaps to enable advancements in megatrends such as artificial intelligence, high-performance computing and advanced connectivity. It partners with leading semiconductor and advanced device manufacturers to address complex challenges and develop solutions that facilitate next-generation technological innovations, and with over 50 years of experience in systems engineering and material science, a global manufacturing footprint and major application labs across the world, it is well-positioned to capitalize on emerging opportunities across various sectors including data centers, communications infrastructure, industrials, automotive and consumer electronics. On May 22, 2024, DuPont de Nemours, Inc. announced its plan to separate Qnity from DuPont into an independent publicly traded company, and on November 1, 2025 DuPont completed the separation and distribution. It is also a leading supplier of innovative materials and processes for organic light-emitting diode displays, having pioneered advanced OLED materials and launched the first mass-produced red phosphorescent OLED host.
